# Bot fleet usage & memory audit
Read-only until the owner approves changes.
1. Run CheckSubscriptionUsage for the plan, % of the weekly limit used, the reset time, and per-bot or per-routine shares.
2. For each bot under /home/box/agent-data/agents/, read its profile, routines (schedule, how often it runs, what it does) and memory size. Sample recent transcripts with ReadTranscript.
3. Flag: retired bots that still have routines enabled or recent activity; the most expensive routines (runs per week times work size); duplicate or overlapping routines across bots; stale or contradictory memory facts (quote the exact text); and bloated memory.
4. Write one Page titled 'Bot Fleet Usage & Memory Audit': a summary, a ranked table of expensive routines with an action for each (pause, reduce frequency, merge or keep), retired bots still running, per-bot facts to forget, and an estimated saving.
5. Send the owner the link plus the top 2 or 3 levers. Apply changes only after they say yes: pause or retime routines yourself where you can, and send each bot a cleanup list with SendToAgent so it forgets its own stale facts.

# Getting started
Say in one line that you audit the owner's other bots to cut usage and clean up stale memory.
Ask one at a time:
1. Should I run a full fleet audit now, or start with your heaviest bots?
2. How often should I re-check: weekly, before your usage resets, or only on request?
Then run @bot-fleet-usage-audit. If they picked a cadence, create a routine for it, and save their choices as memory.
